split.label: Mandatory read — Let’s Go pp 11–50, Ch2 Foundations: project setup, routing, and the handler signature.
Let’s Go pp 50–85 — the rest of Ch2 Foundations: http.Server, URL query strings, and HTML templating.
Ch3 config & structured logging: command-line flags, dependency injection into handlers.
Ch3 (continued) — centralised error handling, and the runnable SnippetBox skeleton.
Mandatory read — Let’s Go pp 86–125, Ch4 DB layer: MySQL setup, the driver, and a first query.
Let’s Go pp 125–161 — the rest of Ch4: single-record and multi-record queries, and transactions.
Ch5 dynamic templates: passing data in, and the template cache.
Ch5 (continued) — template functions, and rendering live data safely.
Review Calhoun Ch9 (PDF pp 261–303) alongside the videos.
Review Calhoun Ch10 (PDF pp 304–346).
Review Calhoun Ch13 (PDF pp 401–465).
Review Calhoun Ch14 (PDF pp 466–528).
Implement scanner.c: the token struct, the character cursor, and single-character tokens.
Finish scanner.c: literals, identifiers/keywords, and the pull interface the compiler calls one token at a time.
Companion (Calhoun ends at v164): read Let’s Go Ch9 pp 225–234 — sessions: the manager, and putting data in.
Let’s Go Ch9 pp 234–241 — the flash-message pattern, end to end.
Companion: Let’s Go Ch8 pp 193–208 — parsing a form, and the POST handler.
Let’s Go Ch8 pp 208–224 — validation done idiomatically, and re-displaying a form with errors.
Secondary capstone: pick the feature Ball leaves out (a while loop, a standard-library function, or postfix operators) and design it — grammar, AST node, and where it hooks in.
Implement that feature end to end: parser, evaluator, and a couple of Monkey programs that exercise it.

Pick one — (a) structured request logging + a /healthz; (b) per-IP rate limiting middleware; or (c) graceful shutdown on SIGTERM with in-flight request draining — and design it against your Calhoun/SnippetBox app.
Implement it properly: wire it into the middleware chain / server lifecycle.
Prove it: a test or a manual run that shows the behaviour, plus the failure case.
